title: tools_plan input
description: Input for tools_plan: a request, plus the tools the model may propose calls to. The tools are DECLARATIONS the model reads; they are never invoked by this package. `tools` is required and non-empty because a plan with no tool set is not a plan — the engine treats an empty or unparseable tool document as 'no tools declared' and returns an empty call, which is indistinguishable from a refusal.

request.description: The user request, verbatim. It reaches the engine as ONE argv element, never interpolated into a command line.

tools.description: The tools offered for this turn. The implementation refuses a proposal naming a tool outside this list rather than passing it through.

system.description: Session facts the model should assume: the date, the locale, the device. Static-prefix text, so a change here changes the cached prefix.

max_new_tokens.description: Response-token budget. The engine's own default is 512; the ceiling here is a deployment limit, not an engine limit.

name.description: The caller-facing tool name a proposal may use. The engine's grammar is constrained by this string, so it is validated before it reaches a tool document.

description.description: What the tool does, for the model. A description that overstates a capability produces proposals for work the tool cannot do.

parameters.description: The tool's JSON Schema `parameters` object. Validated as a JSON Schema before it is written to the engine's tool document; the model's output is constrained by it.
